plain.text: David prays: "Hear me, LORD, my plea is just; listen to my cry." He asks God to judge him fairly. God has examined his heart at night and found nothing wrong. He has kept himself from violent ways and followed God's paths; his feet have not stumbled.

"I call on you, my God, for you will answer me." He asks God to show the wonders of his great love. "Keep me as the apple of your eye; hide me in the shadow of your wings" from the wicked who surround him. They are proud and pitiless, like a lion hungry for prey.

"Rise up, LORD, confront them!" David asks God to rescue him from people whose reward is only in this life. "As for me, I will be vindicated and will see your face; when I awake, I will be satisfied with seeing your likeness."

summary.bigIdea: David asks God to protect him like the "apple of his eye", and finds his true satisfaction in seeing God's face.
points: David asks God to examine him and hear his honest plea.
"Keep me as the apple of your eye; hide me in the shadow of your wings."
Others are satisfied with this life, but David longs to see God's face.
summary.reflection: "Hide me in the shadow of your wings." Where do you need God's shelter right now?
